name: Chanakya Yadav
title: Problem Solver & Builder
bio: I'm a problem solver at heart. By day I'm an Associate Director at S&P Global. By night (and weekends), I vibe code side projects, take help from smarter people, and try to make things that are actually useful to someone.
My philosophy is simple — find a real problem, build the simplest thing that solves it, and ship it. I don't overthink frameworks or processes. I just want to make something people want.

Outside of work, I'm a trivia nerd and history buff. I love learning about anything and everything — building jenga blocks for my mental model of the world. Ask me about obscure historical events and I'll probably have a take.
